encode_sentence_with_roberta: encode a sentence into BPE token IDs using the RoBERTa hub interface
decode_tokens_with_roberta: decode a tensor of RoBERTa token IDs back into human-readable text
extract_features_from_tokens: extract RoBERTa transformer features from encoded token tensors with optional all-hiddens
fill_mask_in_sentence: fill a masked token in a sentence with the top-k most likely predictions
predict_classification_with_roberta: run a classification prediction on encoded tokens using a registered RoBERTa classification head
